title: Stratego: hidden-rank army on 10x10 grid with lakes
description: 10x10 grid, 2 players, 40 pieces each with hidden ranks (1-10 plus bombs and flag). Imperfect information: piece ranks hidden from opponent until combat. Setup phase: simultaneous hidden placement on your half. Movement: 1 cell orthogonal (except scout: slide any distance). Combat: higher rank wins, both removed on tie. Special rules: spy kills marshal only on attack, miners defuse bombs, flag is immobile. Lakes (2x2 impassable zones in center). Win: capture opponent's flag. Demonstrates hidden per-component properties (rank visible only to owner).
